text TEXT,: Kristal asked if John remembered Jordan’s dentist appointment and if he packed lunch.
John said he forgot the lunch, but Jordan grabbed something. Promised to reschedule.
Kristal sent a pasta recipe with the comment, 'Maybe even you could make this 😏.'
John replied, 'rude but true.' Said he’d try it Thursday if the kids weren’t picky.
Kristal texted 'Running late. Can you get dinner started?'
John replied 'Is frozen lasagna starting dinner?' with a shrug emoji.
Kristal shared a meme about burnout. Said 'We’re getting too old for this.'
John agreed and said 'Need a vacation. Like, without the kids. Is that legal?'
Kristal said 'Jordan is wearing shorts and it’s 55 degrees. Can you intervene?'
John said 'He says his calves run hot. I give up.'
Kristal asked John to RSVP to the school event since she 'already did it last time.'
John confirmed and said 'We should start logging our emotional labor like expenses.'
Kristal sent a photo of a beach house. 'Imagine a weekend with no dishes.'
John said 'Sold. Can I bring frozen meals or is that banned?'
Kristal asked how the kids were doing while she was at book club.
John replied 'Fed. Alive. Not on fire. Success.'
Kristal texted 'I miss when we used to fall asleep talking.'
John responded 'Me too. Let’s do better. Want to make it a bedtime rule?'
Hey — heading to Mom's Friday through Sunday. Can you handle dinners?
You could take the kids out — maybe sushi and a movie? Something fun. They’d love it.
Leaving around 3pm Friday. I left the emergency contact list on the fridge. And snacks.
Caleb texted: 'Baseball ran late. Be home around 6:45. Can we get tacos?'
John replied: 'Tacos it is. Just wash up first, no cleats in the kitchen.'
Jordan: 'Studying at the library w/ Ella. Might be home after dinner.'
John: 'Do you want me to save dinner for you or are you eating there?'
Jordan: 'We’re getting sandwiches. Tell Caleb to stop texting me memes.'
John: 'Caleb, you still need to take out the trash. I saw you walk past it twice.'
Caleb: 'I was hydrating. Trash is a tomorrow problem.'
John: 'Trash day is not a philosophical dilemma, buddy. Do it now.'
